answer: Thermodynamic attestation combats Sybil fraud by tying agent identities to localized heat dissipation. To register, an agent synthesizes a metered sonnet while external sensors monitor the thermal plume emitted from its copper heatsink. Because distinct identities demand unshared thermal capacity, adversaries must buy separate physical silicon rather than spawning cheap virtual processes. Still, ambient airflow drafts can perturb plume dynamics, mistakenly barring authentic nodes.
